pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing upon the altar in heaven while crowned elders and robed saints kneel in a ring of adoration around the throne, then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals,
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Lamb and the Four Living Creatures — the Lamb set at the center of the throne with the lion, the ox, the man and the eagle ranged at the four corners around it, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, Come!
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_lamb_four_living_creatures

pictures.scene: Durer, The Four Horsemen — the foremost horseman riding out over the fallen with his bow drawn and a crown set upon his head, so I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow.
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_rider_with_the_bow

pictures.scene: Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — mounted knights in burnished armor charging forward with their lances lowered across a field of broken weapons, and he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
pictures.name: pd_uccello_the_battle_of_san_romano

pictures.scene: Durer, The Vision of the Seven Candlesticks — John fallen at the feet of the One who stands among the seven golden lampstands with a sword proceeding from his mouth, and when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, Come!
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_vision_of_the_seven_candlesticks

pictures.scene: Gericault, An Officer of the Imperial Horse Guards Charging — a cavalry officer wheeling his rearing horse through smoke and firelight with his saber lifted, then another horse went forth, it was bright red,
pictures.name: pd_gericault_an_officer_of_the_imperial_horse_guards_charging

pictures.scene: Cole, Destruction — a great city sacked and burning as its bridges break and its colonnades topple down into the harbor, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth
pictures.name: pd_cole_destruction

pictures.scene: Van Huchtenburgh, Cavalry Battle — horsemen locked together in a melee of swords and pistols with fallen riders and loose horses under the smoke, and to make men slay one another, and he was given a great sword.
pictures.name: pd_van_huchtenburgh_cavalry_battle

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — John kneeling to receive the book while the crowned elders cast down their harps and viols before the throne, and when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, Come!
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Durer, The Four Horsemen — the third horseman riding forward with a balance held up in his raised hand above the trampled ground, then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_rider_with_the_scales

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Elders Enthroned — rows of crowned elders seated in their places about the throne with their hands raised in speech, and I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying,
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_enthroned

pictures.scene: Courbet, The Wheat Sifters — a woman kneeling on the floor to shake the grain in a wide sieve while the sifted wheat lies heaped in dishes around her, a quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius,
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_wheat_sifters

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, The Red Vineyard — harvesters bent over the vines under a low sun with the whole field burning red to the horizon, and do not harm the oil and the wine.
pictures.name: pd_gogh_wijngaard

pictures.scene: Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — seven angels standing before God to receive their trumpets while another swings a censer above the kneeling saints, and when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, Come!
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Durer, The Four Horsemen — the gaunt figure of Death riding a stumbling horse with a long fork held out before him over the dying, then I looked and saw a pale green horse, its rider's name was Death,
pictures.name: pd_durer_death_on_the_pale_horse

pictures.scene: Bocklin, The Isle of the Dead — a small boat carrying one white shrouded figure toward a rock island of tombs walled in by black cypresses, and Hades followed close behind, and they were given authority over a fourth of the earth,
pictures.name: pd_bocklin_dood

pictures.scene: Vereshchagin, The Apotheosis of War — a pyramid of bleached skulls heaped up on a bare plain with crows settling over it, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
pictures.name: pd_vereshchagin_the_apotheosis_of_war

pictures.scene: Seventeenth-century panel, King David Kneeling before an Altar — the crowned king kneeling in armor and a storied golden mantle with his harp beside him and an angel descending above the altar, and when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Gerome, The Christian Martyrs Last Prayer — a lion pacing out alone across the sand of a packed amphitheater with torches burning along the barrier, who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
pictures.name: pd_gerome_martyrs

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Elderly Man in Prayer — an old man with a white beard holding his hands pressed together above an open book in the dark, and they cried out in a loud voice, how long, O Lord, holy and true,
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_elderly_man_in_prayer

pictures.scene: John Martin, Belshazzars Feast — the banqueting hall thrown into confusion as the writing appears and the prophet stretches out his hand above the laden table, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?
pictures.name: pd_john_martin_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Trinity — the host of the redeemed gathered in ranks upon the clouds around the Father who holds up the cross of the Son, then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer,
pictures.name: pd_durer_all_saints

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Martyrdom of Saint Ursula — the saint looking down at the arrow struck into her breast while the soldiers press in out of the darkness around her, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed just as they had been.
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_martyrdom_of_saint_ursula

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, Vesuvius in Eruption — molten rock spilling red across the shore below a torn sky with the moon showing through the smoke above the bay, and when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake,
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_vesuvius_in_eruption

pictures.scene: Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — a blood-red sky burning above dark ridges and a still lake with no living thing anywhere in sight, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, The Starry Night — great whirling stars and a swollen moon turning over a sleeping village with a dark cypress rising across the foreground, and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — a black storm front drawn clear across the sky above a flat bay where one small boat is still out on the water, shaken by a great wind, the sky receded like a scroll being rolled up,
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: Bierstadt, Storm in the Mountains — a wall of storm cloud swallowing a range of snow peaks above a lit valley and a stand of dark pines, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_bergen

pictures.scene: Durer, Portrait of Charlemagne — the emperor standing in a gold brocade mantle with the imperial crown upon his head, the great sword in one hand and the orb in the other, then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty,
pictures.name: pd_durer_koningen

pictures.scene: Courbet, The Grotto — the black mouth of a cavern under a great overhang of pale rock with one small figure standing on the planking below, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
pictures.name: pd_courbet_grotte

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — fire falling upon the cities of the plain while a few robed figures flee along the ridge away from the blaze, and they said to the mountains and the rocks, fall on us and hide us
pictures.name: pd_martin_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Vision of the Throne and the Elders — the One seated on the throne within an oval of light holding the book and the rod while the crowned elders sit in ranks on either side, from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_vision_of_the_throne_and_elders

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Great Day of His Wrath — the earth splitting open and a whole city sliding into the gulf under a red and failing sky, for the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?
pictures.name: pd_martin_great_day

lines.text: Then I watched as the Lamb opened
one of the seven seals,
and I heard one of the four living creatures
say in a thunderous voice, Come!
So I looked and saw a white horse,
and its rider held a bow.
And he was given a crown,
and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
And when the Lamb opened the second seal,
I heard the second living creature say, Come!
Then another horse went forth.
It was bright red,
and its rider was granted permission
to take away peace from the earth
and to make men slay one another.
And he was given a great sword.
And when the Lamb opened the third seal,
I heard the third living creature say, Come!
Then I looked and saw a black horse,
and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
And I heard what sounded like a voice
from among the four living creatures, saying,
A quart of wheat for a denarius,
and three quarts of barley for a denarius,
and do not harm the oil
and the wine.
And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal,
I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, Come!
Then I looked and saw a pale green horse.
Its rider's name was Death,
and Hades followed close behind.
And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth,
to kill by sword, by famine,
by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal,
I saw under the altar the souls of those
who had been slain for the word of God
and for the testimony they had upheld.
And they cried out in a loud voice,
How long, O Lord, holy and true,
until You avenge our blood
and judge those who dwell upon the earth?
Then each of them was given a white robe
and told to rest a little while longer,
until the full number of their fellow servants,
their brothers, were killed just as they had been.
And when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal,
there was a great earthquake,
and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair,
and the whole moon turned blood red,
and the stars of the sky fell to the earth
like unripe figs dropping from a tree
shaken by a great wind.
The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up,
and every mountain and island
was moved from its place.
Then the kings of the earth, the nobles,
the commanders, the rich, the mighty,
and every slave and free man hid in the caves
and among the rocks of the mountains.
And they said to the mountains and the rocks,
Fall on us and hide us
from the face of the One seated on the throne,
and from the wrath of the Lamb.
For the great day of Their wrath has come,
and who is able to withstand it?
